title: Bring the forest home
shortDesc: Decorate your space with festive greenery
fullDesc: Transform your home into a winter wonderland by gathering branches, pinecones, and greenery. Create a beautiful natural centerpiece or wreath that brings the essence of the forest indoors. Perfect for creating a cozy, seasonal atmosphere while enjoying time together.

title: A little mess, a lot of joy
fullDesc: Gather around the kitchen for a festive baking session. Mix the dough, roll it out, cut festive shapes, and decorate with icing, sprinkles, and colorful toppings. The imperfect bits are the best bits—embrace the messy, joyful process of creating together.

title: Stars for our window
shortDesc: Create paper star decorations for your windows
fullDesc: Fold and cut colored paper to create beautiful 3D stars. Arrange them in your windows to catch the light and create a magical display. A galaxy of stars before bedtime brings wonder and joy to the household.

title: Winter walk adventure
shortDesc: Take a nature walk to collect seasonal treasures
fullDesc: Bundle up and venture outdoors to explore winter landscapes. Collect fallen branches, interesting stones, and seasonal foliage. Observe the quiet beauty of the season and take photos of your discoveries. A chance to slow down and notice the little wonders around you.

title: Hot cocoa gathering
shortDesc: Prepare a cozy hot chocolate moment
fullDesc: Brew warm hot chocolate and gather the family for a cozy break. Top with marshmallows, whipped cream, and cinnamon. Share stories, jokes, or favorite memories while warming up together. A simple, intimate moment that brings people closer.

title: Outdoor scavenger hunt
shortDesc: Search for seasonal items in nature
fullDesc: Create a list of winter and holiday items to find: red berries, pinecones, specific leaf shapes, animal tracks, etc. Challenge yourself and family to find as many as possible. Perfect for encouraging observation and appreciation of the natural world.

title: Write festive letters
shortDesc: Create handwritten cards for loved ones
fullDesc: Sit down with pen and paper to write heartfelt messages to friends and family. Share your wishes for the season, memories you cherish, or simple words of appreciation. Personalize envelopes and prepare to send joy through the mail.

title: Movie night marathon
fullDesc: Pick a favorite holiday or family film, prepare cozy seating with blankets and pillows, and gather for a special movie moment. Make it extra special with homemade snacks and no interruptions. Create a tradition of seasonal movie nights.
